method: Referenced vertex sampling, nearest skin-triangle distance and consensus of three oblique ray parities; not clinical validation
femaleGeometry: Runtime partial arm registration applied; other source coordinates unchanged
limitations: All triangle-referenced vertices are checked; this does not test triangle interiors.
Fractions are vertex fractions, not tissue volumes or surface areas.
Surface holes/self-intersections can invalidate parity; topology and ambiguous counts are recorded.
Containment does not establish correct location, orientation, nerve course or source registration.
Separate BP4/CT organ details have no matching whole-body skin in this app and are not merged into the audit.

bodies.interpretation: Surface containment screen only; correct anatomy is NOT established
